facts.note: Sat on alone after dinner with brandy in the dining room; at the temple's ten, his watch showed four minutes to ten.
Went out into the street to smoke at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house.
Piano started in the salon as he lit his cigar at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch; it stopped at eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he heard faint quick bells from the master's window above, with the piano playing all the while.
Came back into the house at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; the hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; he went up to Félix in the library.

added.quote: I did not stay long with him.
added.why: Gives a short, unquantified length for his visit to Félix in the library, which began after his 10:46 return. It suggests he left the library soon after arriving, though no clock time is given.
